lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately 10-12 discernible vertical columns along the mid-lateral flank, with highest density observed immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like pattern; several nodes exhibit bifurcation or irregular cluster formations near the pectoral fin base.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible running longitudinally across the upper flank, each defined by a sharp vertical pixel intensity transition from highlight to shadow.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a sparse distribution of approximately 8-10 high-luminance blobs, primarily clustered toward the anterior and ventral margins of the fin.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a significantly higher density of smaller, high-luminance spots compared to the spacing observed on the primary lateral flank.
